title: Design System: Private Client Graph Public Landing

shadows.name: document-sheet
shadows.purpose: Separate the document sheets within the forest field.

motion.name: document-story
motion.purpose: Documents gather into a connected structure and full-source review.

motion.name: connection-drawing
motion.purpose: Draw canonical connections without changing their dashes or arrows.

motion.name: source-reveal
motion.value: Native smooth internal scrolling; instant with reduced motion

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Green action that leads into the synthetic example or practitioner prototype.
components.html: Explore the example
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 4px; background: #1E6249; color: #FFFFFF; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Landing Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.14s; } .ds-action svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: none; } .ds-action:hover { background: #173F31; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1E6249; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Document Sheet
components.description: A distinct attendance, email, time-sheet or legal document within the scroll-controlled fan.
components.html:
Attendance note

Case 01 · Actual synthetic source excerpts

Alice Chen confirmed that she and David Chen are spouses.
components.css: .ds-sheet { max-width: 450px; padding: 26px 32px; border-radius: 4px; background: #F3F5EF; color: #203D30; box-shadow: 0 13px 36px #0B27194D; font: 400 14px/1.55 'Landing Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-sheet h3 { margin: 0 0 7px; font-size: 20px; } .ds-sheet .ds-meta { margin: 0 0 20px; color: #506858; font-size: 11px; } .ds-sheet span { background: #DCE8CA; }

components.name: Relationship Choice
components.description: Canonical relationship label with complete accessible statement, pressed state and visible focus.
components.html: <button class="ds-relationship" aria-label="Alice Chen — parent of — Bob Chen" aria-pressed="true">parent of</button>
components.css: .ds-relationship { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #729582; border-radius: 22px; background: #173F31; color: #E3EDE1; font: 400 12px/1.5 'Landing Public Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-relationship:hover, .ds-relationship[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #E3F1B4; color: #173F31; border-color: #E3F1B4; } .ds-relationship:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #C8E8A6; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Full Source Review
components.description: Complete API source text with exact Evidence highlights and independently scrollable reading pane.
components.html:
Attendance note

Source: source_001 · Evidence: evidence_005

Alice Chen was asked first to confirm her own connection with the Evergreen Family Trust. She confirmed that she is the settlor of the Evergreen Family Trust.
components.css: .ds-source { max-width: 480px; background: #F3F5EF; color: #203D30; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; font: 400 14px/1.75 'Landing Public Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-source header { padding: 22px 25px 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid #CAD8C8; } .ds-source h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-source header p { margin: 0; color: #4B6354; font-size: 10px; } .ds-reader { max-height: 220px; padding: 25px; overflow: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; scrollbar-color: #76927D #F3F5EF; } .ds-reader p { margin: 0; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-reader mark { background: #D4E6A5; color: #173F31; padding: 2px 0; border-radius: 2px; box-decoration-break: clone; } .ds-reader:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1E6249; outline-offset: -4px; }

components.name: Skip to Review
components.description: Skips the scroll sequence and focuses the finished relationship review.
components.css: .ds-skip-review { display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; color: #173F31; font: 400 12px/1.5 'Landing Public Sans', sans-serif; text-underline-offset: 5px; } .ds-skip-review:hover { color: #1E6249; } .ds-skip-review:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1E6249; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Wordmark, research, practitioner entry and language selection.
components.html: Private Client GraphResearchOpen practitioner prototype
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 24px; min-height: 82px; margin: 0 5%; border-bottom: 1px solid #C7D3C8; color: #20372B; font: 400 13px/1.5 'Landing Public Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav .ds-brand { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-nav .ds-enter { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .ds-nav svg { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: none; } .ds-nav select { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; font: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible, .ds-nav select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1E6249; outline-offset: 5px; } .ds-nav .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); }

narrative.northStar: Build the structure. Keep the Evidence.
narrative.overview: The approved document montage gathers attendance notes, emails, time sheets and legal documents into a proposed relationship structure, then reveals the full source beside the same graph.
keyCharacteristics: A continuous forest field through proposal review, with light only returning at research content.
Exact full-source Evidence and canonical graph semantics.
Keyboard skip, static reduced-motion alternative and English/Chinese continuity.

rules.name: Colour Continuity
rules.body: Keep story and proposal review in one forest field, with spacing inside sections.

rules.name: Exact Source
rules.body: Preserve every source character and attribute highlights only to canonical Evidence.

rules.name: Product Vision
rules.body: Label illustrative formats; the working synthetic example supplies the actual graph and Evidence.

dos: Respect reduced motion and manual source scrolling.
Preserve relationship selection through reverse scrolling.
Retain canonical names, IDs, direction, dashes and exact quotes.
donts: Do not add an empty light separator between green sections.
Do not invent multi-source Evidence from the illustrative formats.
Do not import the throwaway prototype into the production landing.
